column1: # Suhalla town: before and after Babi's audience; includes NPC Mind Read states.

column3:
This is Suhalla. Stay
clear of the desert while
the storms are raging.{page_break}The winds can swallow a
traveler before anyone
can reach them.{end_wait}
Are you trying to reach\nLalivero?{end_now}

We Gondowans have no
reason to trust Angara.
Not after what they did.{page_break}{actor_name:7} was taken as a
hostage to keep Lalivero
under Tolbi's control.{end_wait}

For generations, people
have said the desert
spirits stir the storms...{page_break}when angered by the
things people do.{end_wait}

Can anyone reach southern
Gondowan from here?{page_break}The rivers and broken
land make a crossing
nearly impossible.{end_wait}
The workers speak of\nTolbi's great festival.\nI wish I could see it.{end_wait}

The storms grew violent
without warning.{page_break}I hope no one else is
left out there when the
next one comes.{end_wait}
Suhalla has always known\nsandstorms. Lately, they\ncome too often.{end_wait}

Angaran soldiers have
worked Lalivero's people
to the bone.{page_break}We speak of their pain,
but what have we done
to help them?{end_wait}

{actor_name:7} was taken as a
hostage to keep Lalivero
under Tolbi's control.{page_break}We will not forget
what Babi has done, nor
forgive it easily.{end_wait}
The desert spirits will\nmake Babi answer for\nwhat he has done.{end_wait}

The land itself guards
southern Gondowan. Few
can cross it safely.{page_break}Still, we watch the north.
An Angaran army could
come one day.{end_wait}

They say Colosso draws
warriors from far away.
Tolbi cheers them on.{page_break}I wonder if anyone
there remembers what
those fighters risk.{end_wait}
When the storms rise,\nthe adults stay indoors.\nNo one argues with them.{end_wait}
Welcome to Suhalla. The\nstorms must have been\nterrible out there.{end_wait}
The desert has vanished\nbehind a wall of sand.\nIt's frightening.{end_wait}

Tolbi's soldiers were
caught in the storms.
Some barely survived.{page_break}The wounded were brought
to a house nearby.
They need time to heal.{end_wait}
The storm carried us\nhere before we could\nfind shelter.{end_wait}

The Angarans brought
this upon us!{page_break}The tower they forced
Lalivero to build may
have stirred the spirits.{end_wait}
The storm swept you\ninto Suhalla, didn't it?{end_now}

The storms seem to choose
who they strike. They
move like living things.{page_break}What kind of force can
turn the desert against
those who cross it?{end_wait}
The soldiers kept\nwhispering about shapes\ninside the storm.{end_wait}
Those warriors must have\nbeen swept here by the\nsame terrible winds.{end_wait}
The storms were not this\nfrequent until recently.{pause_20_skippable}\nWhat changed?{end_wait}
The Tolbi soldiers fell\nlike men who had already\nfought a losing battle.{end_wait}

Once a storm takes you,
you have only moments
before it throws you back.{page_break}You can struggle all
you like. There is no
way to fight the wind.{end_wait}

The storms have grown
stronger with each day.{page_break}What could have angered
the desert spirits so
completely?{end_wait}

Fight a death storm and
you invite the spirits'
wrath.{page_break}Perhaps that is what
brought the Tolbi soldiers
to their knees.{end_wait}

The adults say the storms
attack people. But how
can a storm choose?{page_break}It is only wind and sand.
Isn't it?{end_wait}

They say the soldiers
were torn apart by the
storms...{page_break}I think something was
hiding inside the wind.{end_wait}
A sandstorm!{end_wait}
